newsitem.title: JAPAN: Jun 14-Jul 13 rainfall average for most of Japan.
newsitem.headline: Jun 14-Jul 13 rainfall average for most of Japan.

text.p: Japan, now in its rainy season, is expected to see average temperatures in northern, eastern and western Japan during the June 14 to July 13 period, the Meteorological Agency said on Friday.
Temperatures in the southwestern islands are likely to be lower than average, it said.
Average rainfall is expected during the period.
The agency said it expected to see more than average hours of sunshine during the period for eastern Japan, and about average for northern and western Japan, as well as the southwestern islands.
